final: WITH player_stats AS (SELECT bps.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bps.double) as avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bps JOIN player p ON bps.player_id = p.player_id WHERE bps.double IS NOT NULL AND p.bats IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bps.player_id, p.bats), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_avg FROM player_stats), player_index AS (SELECT ps.player_id, ps.bats, ps.avg_doubles, ps.avg_doubles / oa.overall_avg as index_val FROM player_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), hand_averages AS (SELECT bats, AVG(index_val) as hand_avg_index FROM player_index GROUP BY bats), player_gaps AS (SELECT pi.player_id, pi.bats, pi.avg_doubles, pi.index_val, pi.index_val - ha.hand_avg_index as gap FROM player_index pi JOIN hand_averages ha ON pi.bats = ha.bats) SELECT player_id, bats as batting_hand, avg_doubles, index_val as index_value, gap FROM player_gaps ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
